entities.name: Saitō Takao
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Saitō Takao  was a Japanese politician and longtime member of the Imperial Diet as a member of the Rikken Minseitō party. He was born in the village of Izushi-gun in Hyōgo and in the Diet represented the rural Tajima area.
